name: Announce every-third-stop express in advance
description: Start 12 stops and four evenly spaced buses with fixed passenger arrivals. Hold Bus 1 for 60 seconds at minute 20. At minute 25, announce an every-third-stop pattern for Bus 1: serve its current service stop, or next stop if moving, and six more locations normally, then skip two and serve one for 12 locations, capped at 30 minutes from announcement. Accepted drop-offs remain protected; new passengers board only if their destination's first upcoming visit is served. Compare queue waits and passengers passed over against the same delay alone.
